text:
maria-sec: Heads-up: auth team found a session refresh token replay issue in the SSO proxy. An attacker who obtained a refresh token could reuse it after logout for ~48h. Classifying as high severity. See internal advisory: https://redwood.internal/security/advisories/SSO-REF-2026
sec-bot: :warning: Detector oauth-replay-rate triggered (evt oauth-2543216789). Spike in refresh usage from single IP across multiple user IDs.
tom-auth: Confirmed. Root cause appears to be missing single-use nonce on refresh endpoint and long refresh token TTL. Patch ready to enforce nonces + shorten TTL to 1h.
josh-platform: Blast radius: all customers using SSO proxy (prod and staging) + internal staff SSO. Need coordinated rotation/invalidations and a deploy pump.
maria-sec: Immediate actions (short list):
1) Disable long-lived refresh acceptance and enable one-time nonce enforcement in proxy config (toggle: sso.refresh_nonce_enforce=true).
2) Shorten refresh TTL in env: REFRESH_TTL=3600.
3) Revoke refresh tokens issued in last 72h via revocation API and force re-login.
4) Notify legal if any customer sessions suspected.

tom-auth: Pushing hotfix to canary now. Will enable nonce enforcement in canary and monitor for errors for 10m before full rollout. Command: `kubectl set env deployment/sso-proxy REFRESH_TTL=3600 --namespace=prod`

josh-platform: I'll prepare the token revocation job. Plan: query token store for tokens issued in last 72h, batch revoke (5k/min), and funnel affected user sessions to login flow. Ticket: TKT-SEC-254321-SSOREF.

elaine-legal: Please add me to the ticket. If we find evidence of cross-tenant access or account takeover, we will coordinate customer notification and regulator triage.

maria-sec: Monitoring plan: increase alerting on refresh failures and anomalous reuse patterns, enable debug logs for sso-proxy for 30m, and capture offending IPs for SOC.

sec-bot: Policy note: SEC-SESSION-1 mandates revocation and legal review for token replay with confirmed reuse. Add incident timeline to ticket TKT-SEC-254321-SSOREF.

tom-auth: Canary results: no rollback, nonce enforcement accepted, error rate stable. Rolling out to 50% in 8m, full production in 20m if green.

josh-platform: Revocation job queued. Will run canary revoke for affected internal users then escalate to customer tenants in the next phase after legal OK.

maria-sec: Communication: Internal advisory to all engineers — force re-auth for internal tools and rotate any automation tokens that rely on refresh grants. Customer-facing notice drafted but on hold pending legal.

elaine-legal: Agreed. We'll review the draft and set notification thresholds. Add me to all updates in the ticket.

maria-sec: Owners: @tom-auth (fix + rollout), @josh-platform (revocation), @maria-sec (investigation + SOC coordination), @elaine-legal (legal coord). Post-incident report and mitigation plan due in 5 business days. :shield:
